structured:
{"@context":"https://schema.org/","@type":"JobPosting","title":"Senior Full-Stack Builder","description":"

Senior Full-Stack Builder

Location: Remote (Latin America) | Type: Full-time

About Katapult

Katapult is an AI-first engineering studio connecting senior LATAM talent with startups and companies in the US. We're not a staff-augmentation shop: every person we put in front of a client represents Katapult, co-creates product, and owns the outcome directly, with no managers or leads acting as a layer in between.

About the role

We're not looking for a developer who executes tickets. We're looking for a builder engineer: someone with full product vision, able to move across architecture, backend, frontend, mobile and UX without waiting for someone else to tell them what to do (part Full-stack Engineer, part Designer, part Product Manager).

Technical depth is the floor here, not the differentiator. What actually sets builders apart is how they orchestrate AI agents day to day (planning work, running things in parallel, reviewing output critically), the harness they leave behind so agents and humans can keep running reliably on their work, and how well they see product, market and channel as one connected system rather than isolated tickets. Excellent communication is core to this role: you'll need to articulate product decisions clearly, align with stakeholders across functions, and make your reasoning legible to both humans and the AI agents you're directing because in a role this autonomous, how well you communicate is often what determines how far your work actually scales.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build product end-to-end alongside the client: architecture, data model, integrations, and the final interface, always with an eye on where each piece fits in the bigger picture.

  • Work in lean teams, typically starting at 2-3 people and scaling as the project grows, always with direct client exposure and no manager or lead absorbing that communication on your behalf.

  • Translate ambiguous business needs into a clear, executable technical plan, and argue for the why behind your decisions, not just the what.

  • Give proactive, honest updates and know when and how to push back on scope, asking the right questions early before a technical issue becomes a trust issue with the client. Invisible work reads as no work.

  • Use AI tools (like Claude and Claude Design) as a daily speed multiplier, leaving behind the context, rules, and tests that let agents run reliably on your work going forward. Katapult covers the cost of top-tier tooling so you can work at full capacity.

  • Co-create with the client rather than simply taking orders; actively help shape product decisions, not just implement them.

What we're looking for

  • Fluent English, enough to hold product and architecture conversations directly with US-based clients. This is client-facing work, so it's non-negotiable.

  • Solid full stack experience (backend + frontend); mobile or micro-frontend experience is a plus.

  • A track record of turning fuzzy product conversations into working architecture quickly, thinking about scalability, access control, and integrations from day one.

  • Real seniority: comfortable running an engagement solo when the client needs it, with a track record that includes both wins and lessons learned.

  • Prior experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders; startup or product-consulting backgrounds are a strong fit.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow, including planning and reviewing agent output critically, not just running prompts.

How we work

  • Our best-performing engagements are the ones where we co-create with the client at a strategic level, not the ones where we simply execute instructions.

  • Everyone on a project shares responsibility for communicating the value Katapult brings, consistently, not just shipping quietly in the background

Work-Life Balance

  • Work from Anywhere in Latin America: Enjoy the freedom to work remotely from any country in Latin America.

  • 23 Days of PTO per Year: Take time to recharge with paid time off, accrued monthly (1.91 days/month).

  • USA Federal Holidays

Financial Benefits

  • Monthly Payment in USD: Get paid in US dollars, no matter where you are.

  • Contractor Agreement with No End Date: Enjoy the stability of a long-term contract.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer @ SimSpace Corporation
structured:
{"@context":"https://schema.org/","@type":"JobPosting","title":"Senior Fullstack Engineer","description":"

SimSpace serves as an AI Proving Ground where organizations can confidently train, test, and outmaneuver adversaries in any environment. Trusted by allied governments, militaries, enterprises, and research institutions worldwide, SimSpace enables adaptive, AI-ready defenses that stay ahead of evolving threats. Founded in 2015 by experts from U.S. Cyber Command and MIT Lincoln Laboratory, the platform unifies training, testing, and validation in a realistic, live-fire simulation—helping teams evaluate security investments, optimize performance, and compress cyber readiness cycles from months to days.

Why join SimSpace? We are an organization that is focused on building our culture and mindfully enhancing our atmosphere every day which is why we have collaborated on an integral value system. Our governing philosophy of being Human Centered is deeply embedded within our value system. We apply this philosophy to every one of our internal team members, external clients, and their customers.

How Do We Work? We believe that people are at the center of everything we do. SimSpace fosters a culture of continuous learning, curiosity, and professional growth. That belief shows up in action: in-house training, internal and external learning platforms, cyber conferences, industry events, and dedicated time for skill development. Our people are empowered to shape their careers - and it shows. Year over year, SimSpace consistently outperforms industry benchmarks in internal mobility, promotions, and total rewards growth.

Who Thrives Here? We are a team of innovators, protectors, and problem-solvers. We believe diversity of thought and experience fuels better solutions, and we’re committed to building teams that reflect the communities we serve. Whether you’re remote or office-based, you’ll collaborate with talented colleagues across departments and time zones, united by the mission to create a safer digital world.

We invite you to apply today!

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build the operator experience for SimSpace’s internet simulation platform. This engineer will turn the platform’s control-plane capabilities into intuitive workflows for configuring simulated services, registering personas, managing topology, provisioning applications, integrating ranges, and monitoring platform state.

The role will work closely with the backend engineer who owns the control-plane API, event-driven orchestration, persistence, and deployment model. While the primary focus will be building the frontend experience in React and TypeScript, this engineer will also contribute to backend services and integration layers where needed. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving across the stack, translating complex distributed-system behavior into clear user experiences, and building interfaces that remain understandable when operations are asynchronous, long-running, or partially successful.

What you will help build

  • The web-based operator experience for configuring and managing the internet simulation platform across multiple ranges and environments

  • React and TypeScript workflows for creating services, registering personas, managing topology, provisioning simulated SaaS applications, delivering scenario content, and querying platform state

  • Reusable frontend architecture, components, and design patterns that support a growing collection of platform capabilities

  • Integration between the frontend and the control-plane API, including authentication, authorization, validation, error handling, asynchronous operations, and real-time status updates

  • Operational views that make platform state, deployment health, range connectivity, failures, and recovery actions understandable to users

  • Backend endpoints, service integrations, and supporting logic in collaboration with the engineer who owns the control plane

  • Testing and delivery practices that allow the frontend and backend to evolve together without breaking operator workflows

What you will do

  • Design and build the platform’s frontend using React and TypeScript, creating clear workflows for technically sophisticated operators

  • Translate complex platform operations—such as standing up a range, registering a persona, provisioning a service, or updating topology—into intuitive, observable user experiences

  • Build reusable components and frontend patterns for forms, resource configuration, status reporting, validation, error handling, and long-running operations

  • Integrate the frontend with the control-plane API, ensuring API contracts are used consistently and failures are presented with enough context for users to understand and recover

  • Partner with the backend engineer on API design so that frontend requirements, user workflows, and operational needs are reflected in the platform’s interfaces

  • Contribute to backend services and integration layers where needed, including implementing supporting endpoints, evolving data models, and troubleshooting cross-stack issues

  • Develop views for platform health, range connectivity, service lifecycle, operation history, and partial-failure recovery

  • Implement appropriate state-management and data-fetching patterns for a multi-tenant platform with asynchronous and event-driven backend behavior

  • Build automated tests across the frontend stack, including component, integration, and end-to-end coverage for critical operator workflows

  • Improve frontend performance, accessibility, security, and maintainability as the product and engineering team grow

  • Collaborate with product, design, backend, network simulation, and SRE partners to deliver cohesive features across the full platform

  • Help establish frontend development standards, code-review practices, observability, release processes, and documentation for the user experience


Who you are:

  • Strong experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript

  • Experience designing and delivering complex operator interfaces, administrative consoles, infrastructure-management products, or other workflow-heavy applications

  • Strong frontend architecture skills, including component design, application state management, data fetching, routing, forms, validation, and error handling

  • Experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful or similar platform APIs

  • An understanding of asynchronous and distributed-system behavior and the ability to represent long-running operations, partial failures, retries, and eventual consistency clearly in a user interface

  • Backend development experience, preferably with Kotlin and Spring Boot, or the ability to become productive in that stack

  • Experience collaborating on API schemas and contracts with backend engineers

  • Strong testing practices across unit, component, integration, and end-to-end testing

  • Familiarity with authentication, authorization, secrets handling, and secure frontend development

  • Experience instrumenting applications so that failures can be diagnosed across browser, API, and backend service boundaries

  • Strong product and user-experience instincts, particularly when simplifying technically complex workflows

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work closely with engineers across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and operations

We’re proud to offer a competitive and comprehensive package designed to support your well-being, growth, and success:

  • Compensation. Base monthly pay range: 1,500,000 CRC - 2,500,000 CRC reflecting our confidence in your expertise and impact, with the opportunity for annual bonuses tied to company performance and individual contributions.

    • Health & Wellness. Private medical, dental, vision, and life benefits.

    • Mental Health Support. Access to company-paid counseling, coaching, and resources for you and your family through Spring Health.

    • Parental Leave. Paid leave plans to support you and your loved ones during life’s most important moments.

    • Ownership Opportunities. Equity stock options at hire, with annual performance-based grants—become an invested stakeholder in our shared success.

    • Continuous Learning. Access a LinkedIn Learning membership to prioritize your personal and professional development.

    • Social Connections. Monthly reimbursements for meaningful connections with teammates through our SocialSpace Community.

SimSpace is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

SimSpace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all members of our staff, clients, volunteers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend @ SimSpace Corporation
structured:
{"@context":"https://schema.org/","@type":"JobPosting","title":"Senior Software Engineer, Backend","description":"

SimSpace serves as an AI Proving Ground where organizations can confidently train, test, and outmaneuver adversaries in any environment. Trusted by allied governments, militaries, enterprises, and research institutions worldwide, SimSpace enables adaptive, AI-ready defenses that stay ahead of evolving threats. Founded in 2015 by experts from U.S. Cyber Command and MIT Lincoln Laboratory, the platform unifies training, testing, and validation in a realistic, live-fire simulation—helping teams evaluate security investments, optimize performance, and compress cyber readiness cycles from months to days.

Why join SimSpace? We are an organization that is focused on building our culture and mindfully enhancing our atmosphere every day which is why we have collaborated on an integral value system. Our governing philosophy of being Human Centered is deeply embedded within our value system. We apply this philosophy to every one of our internal team members, external clients, and their customers.

How Do We Work? We believe that people are at the center of everything we do. SimSpace fosters a culture of continuous learning, curiosity, and professional growth. That belief shows up in action: in-house training, internal and external learning platforms, cyber conferences, industry events, and dedicated time for skill development. Our people are empowered to shape their careers - and it shows. Year over year, SimSpace consistently outperforms industry benchmarks in internal mobility, promotions, and total rewards growth.

Who Thrives Here? We are a team of innovators, protectors, and problem-solvers. We believe diversity of thought and experience fuels better solutions, and we’re committed to building teams that reflect the communities we serve. Whether you’re remote or office-based, you’ll collaborate with talented colleagues across departments and time zones, united by the mission to create a safer digital world.

We invite you to apply today!

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the orchestration engine at the heart of SimSpace's internet simulation platform. Every action in the platform, standing up a simulated service, registering a persona, pushing a topology update to a range, delivering a file to a scenario, provisioning a SaaS application, flows through the control plane this engineer owns. Where the other engineering roles on the team build the simulation layers themselves, this role builds the system that ties them together: the API surface that external systems call, the event-driven backbone that coordinates actions across subsystems, and the deployment and operational model that keeps a complex, multi-tenant platform running reliably across many concurrent range deployments. If you are energized by building systems that other engineers depend on and have strong instincts for distributed systems correctness and operational rigor, this role is for you.

The team is responsible for:

  • The control plane API: the external-facing interface through which range orchestration, scenario management, and user emulation systems drive the internet simulation platform, creating services, registering personas, updating topology, and querying state

  • The event-driven orchestration backbone that coordinates actions across the platform's simulation layers, network, services, identity, and storage, and maintains consistent state across a distributed, multi-range deployment

  • Persistent storage infrastructure for the platform: service data, content corpora, certificate stores, topology state, and the volumes that simulated services depend on

  • The deployment and operational model for the internet simulation platform itself as a long-lived Kubernetes-native product, including upgrade paths, multi-range scaling, and the configuration model for new range integrations

  • In-range proxy agent infrastructure in collaboration with the network simulation tech lead: the components that bridge the control plane to individual range deployments and maintain platform presence within each range

What will you be doing as a Senior Software Engineer, Backend SimSpace?

  • Design and build the control plane API: the interface that range orchestration and scenario systems use to drive the internet simulation platform, with strong attention to idempotency, consistent error semantics, and the operational patterns that make a platform API pleasant to build on

  • Own the event-driven orchestration layer that coordinates multi-step operations across the platform's subsystems, ensuring that standing up a new range, registering a persona, incorporating a SaaS application, or updating topology propagates correctly and completely across all components

  • Build and maintain the platform's persistent storage layer, providing reliable, well-abstracted storage primitives for the services and subsystems that depend on it, across file, object, and container storage as requirements evolve

  • Own the deployment model for the internet simulation platform itself: the Kubernetes operators or controllers that manage platform lifecycle, the upgrade and rollout strategy for a service that cannot afford downtime, and the configuration model for integrating new ranges

  • Define and own the state model for the platform, what is authoritative where, how components recover from partial failures, and how the platform converges to a correct state after disruption

  • Collaborate with the network simulation tech lead on the in-range proxy agent architecture, owning the infrastructure side of that interface: agent deployment, connectivity management, and the handoff model when an agent loses contact with the control plane

  • Partner with the SRE team on the operational model for a new platform service, establishing runbooks, incident response procedures, and the observability instrumentation that makes the platform debuggable in production

  • Contribute to cross-cutting concerns including configuration management, secrets handling, and the security posture of the control plane

Who you are:

  • Experience Building backend from scratch, preferably using Kotlin and Spring Boot

  • Strong API design instincts, you have built platform APIs that other engineers depend on and understand what makes an API surface reliable, consistent, and operationally sound over time

  • Solid distributed systems fundamentals: you can reason clearly about consistency, failure modes, and convergence in a system where a central control plane coordinates distributed components that may lose connectivity or fail mid-operation

  • Experience building event-driven or message-driven systems, with an understanding of the tradeoffs involved in different coordination approaches, the implementation will be informed by the architecture, not the other way around

  • Strong Kubernetes expertise including writing operators or controllers, managing custom resources, and reasoning about multi-tenant workload isolation

  • Experience designing and operating storage systems across different storage paradigms, file, object, and block or container storage, and choosing the right abstraction for each use case

  • Operational rigor: you instrument what you build, write runbooks, and think about failure modes before they become incidents

  • Experience with air-gapped or on-premises Kubernetes deployments is a strong plus given SimSpace's customer and deployment model

  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps-based deployment workflows

We’re proud to offer a competitive and comprehensive package designed to support your well-being, growth, and success:

  • Compensation. Base monthly pay range: 1,500,000 CRC - 2,500,000 CRC reflecting our confidence in your expertise and impact, with the opportunity for annual bonuses tied to company performance and individual contributions.

    • Health & Wellness. Private medical, dental, vision, and life benefits.

    • Mental Health Support. Access to company-paid counseling, coaching, and resources for you and your family through Spring Health.

    • Parental Leave. Paid leave plans to support you and your loved ones during life’s most important moments.

    • Ownership Opportunities. Equity stock options at hire, with annual performance-based grants—become an invested stakeholder in our shared success.

    • Continuous Learning. Access a LinkedIn Learning membership to prioritize your personal and professional development.

    • Social Connections. Monthly reimbursements for meaningful connections with teammates through our SocialSpace Community.

SimSpace is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

SimSpace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all members of our staff, clients, volunteers, subcontractors, vendors, and clients.

See something that should exist? Build it.
See a better way? Do it.

At Terrific, every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI.

And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms.


Principal Engineer

Terrific • LATAM • Contract, Remote

About Terrific

Terrific Live is a social commerce platform that helps retailers and eCommerce brands grow revenue through live, interactive, social-native shopping experiences on their own websites. Our platform connects audiences and shop presenters in real time — streaming to global brands, retailers, and media groups across Latin America, Europe, and Israel — and turns live moments into measurable sales.

We’re hiring a Principal Engineer to set the technical direction of the platform, raise the engineering bar, and help us scale a 24/7, high-availability, AI-powered product to the next order of magnitude.

The Role

The Principal Engineer is our most senior individual contributor - a force-multiplier across the entire engineering organization. You’ll own architecture and technical strategy for Terrific’s platform end-to-end: real-time live video commerce, AI/ML-driven personalization, commerce integrations, data infrastructure, and everything in between.

You’ll stay deeply hands-on — writing code, reviewing designs, and shipping critical systems — while also shaping how the team builds: standards, patterns, performance, and reliability. You’ll partner closely with the R&D managers, Product manager, and Design on the hardest, highest-leverage problems.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end architecture of the Terrific platform across backend, frontend, data, AI,  and real-time systems.

  • Drive engineering standards - code quality, testing, observability, security, and operational excellence - and raise the bar across the team.

  • Mentor engineers; grow the technical depth of the organization.

  • Design and implement new services and features end-to-end, from database to UI, with high performance and responsiveness.

  • Build rapid prototype features A to Z.

  • Tackle the highest-risk, highest-impact problems personally - live video reliability, real-time engagement, commerce integrations, and AI-powered experiences.

  • Evolve our stack thoughtfully: React, Angular, Node.js, TypeScript, GCP, Firebase, Firestore, Cloud Functions, BigQuery, and Pub/Sub.

  • Architect for global, 24/7 live operation — uptime, latency, cost, and graceful degradation during peak live events.

  • Build for B2B2C scale: systems that serve enterprise customers (brands, retailers, broadcasters) and their consumer audiences across multiple regions and languages.

  • Partner with Product and Data on experimentation infrastructure so every meaningful change can be A/B tested and measured.

  • Partner with Product and Design from concept through launch, taking full ownership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Represent engineering with strategic customers and partners on deep technical topics; translate customer reality into architectural decisions.

  • Make the whole team better - through design reviews, technical writing, mentorship, and hiring.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a track record of leading at staff/principal level at high-scale products(!).

  • Expert-level Node.js and TypeScript; strong frontend experience in React and/or Angular (both a significant plus).

  • Deep experience designing and operating distributed, real-time systems in production, 24/7, under load.

  • Strong data engineering instincts: SQL/NoSQL, event-driven architectures, and analytical stores (BigQuery or equivalent).

  • Hands-on experience building or shipping AI/ML-powered features in production - personalization, recommendations, search, or generative AI.

  • Experience on GCP (Firebase, Cloud Functions, Firestore, Realtime Database, Pub/Sub) is a strong advantage.

  • Experience with commerce platforms such as Shopify or WooCommerce, and/or live video/streaming infrastructure, is a plus.

  • Excellent judgment on trade-offs between scope, speed, performance, and UX; strong product intuition.

  • Clear, calm communicator: writes well, pushes back thoughtfully, and makes the people around them more effective.

Why Terrific

  • Principal-level ownership of the platform that defines live, shoppable media.

  • Real, global scale — top brands, retailers, and broadcasters, running 24/7 across LatAm, Europe, and Israel.

  • A modern stack (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Angular, GCP, Firebase, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) with the autonomy to evolve it.

  • A tight, senior team where product, design, data, and engineering ship together

\n


\n

Required:

  • Deep experience in at least one of Terrific’s three commercial pillars — eCommerce, Marketing, or Media — and enough fluency across the other two to contribute credibly from day 1.
  • Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language. As such, all roles require fluency in written and spoken English.

 

Be part of the change that’s quietly reshaping how people discover and buy online.
Passionate about social media and e-commerce? Come build what’s next at Terrific.

 

Please note: We review every application carefully. While we may not be able to respond to everyone, we will reach out to candidates whose experience aligns with what we’re building.

Partner with Product and Data on experimentation infrastructure so every meaningful change can be A/B tested and measured. Partner with Product and Design from concept through launch, taking full ownership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Represent engineering with strategic customers and partners on deep technical topics; translate customer reality into architectural decisions. Make the whole team better - through design reviews, technical writing, mentorship, and hiring. What We’re Looking For 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with a track record of leading at staff/principal level at high-scale products(!). Expert-level Node.js and TypeScript; strong frontend experience in React and/or Angular (both a significant plus). Deep experience designing and operating distributed, real-time systems in production, 24/7, under load. Strong data engineering instincts: SQL/NoSQL, event-driven architectures, and analytical stores (BigQuery or equivalent). Hands-on experience building or shipping AI/ML-powered features in production - personalization, recommendations, search, or generative AI. Experience on GCP (Firebase, Cloud Functions, Firestore, Realtime Database, Pub/Sub) is a strong advantage. Experience with commerce platforms such as Shopify or WooCommerce, and/or live video/streaming infrastructure, is a plus. Excellent judgment on trade-offs between scope, speed, performance, and UX; strong product intuition. Clear, calm communicator: writes well, pushes back thoughtfully, and makes the people around them more effective. Why Terrific Principal-level ownership of the platform that defines live, shoppable media. Real, global scale — top brands, retailers, and broadcasters, running 24/7 across LatAm, Europe, and Israel. A modern stack (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Angular, GCP, Firebase, BigQuery, Pub/Sub) with the autonomy to evolve it. A tight, senior team where product, design, data, and engineering ship together Required: Deep experience in at least one of Terrific’s three commercial pillars — eCommerce, Marketing, or Media — and enough fluency across the other two to contribute credibly from day 1. Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language. As such, all roles require fluency in written and spoken English. Be part of the change that’s quietly reshaping how people discover and buy online.Passionate about social media and e-commerce? Come build what’s next at Terrific. Lead-level frontend and mobile ownership. AI-first delivery. Architecture decisions.

We are looking for a highly senior engineer who can operate at Lead Engineer level across frontend and mobile applications.

This is not a role for someone who only executes tickets. We need someone who can make architecture decisions independently, design scalable frontend and mobile systems, and turn ambiguous product needs into production-ready applications.

This is a high-ownership role on a lean team. The default mode of execution is AI-first. Engineers use AI agents and tools such as Cursor, Claude, and similar platforms to accelerate research, planning, implementation, testing, and refinement, but ownership stays fully with the engineer. The person in this role must be able to use AI to move fast while maintaining strong judgment around architecture, correctness, performance, usability, maintainability, and overall product quality.

The work

  • Design and own frontend and mobile application architecture across React, React Native, and Next.js

  • Make architecture decisions independently, with a focus on scalability, maintainability, performance, and reliability

  • Build production-grade applications using TypeScript across web and mobile environments

  • Work with GraphQL APIs and define clean integration patterns across frontend, mobile, and API layers

  • Define scalable engineering patterns across React, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, and GraphQL

  • Own application quality standards across architecture, code structure, testing, responsiveness, and developer experience

  • Define technical direction, not just implementation details

  • Set and enforce quality standards across both AI-generated and manually written code

  • Use AI-first and agentic development workflows with tools such as Cursor and Claude to accelerate delivery without compromising engineering standards

  • Translate ambiguous product needs into clear technical solutions

  • Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications across web and mobile

  • Collaborate directly with clients to ensure smooth communication and strong understanding of requirements

  • Contribute to system design, performance strategy, testing strategy, and engineering productivity

  • Apply a basic understanding of native mobile development concepts in Kotlin/Java and Objective-C/Swift when working with React Native integrations, debugging, or platform-specific requirements

This is a fast-paced environment with real production stakes. You will be expected to move quickly, think at systems level, and make strong technical decisions with minimal hand-holding. If you are comfortable owning frontend and mobile architecture, working across React, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and AI-first workflows, and raising the technical bar in a high-accountability environment, this role is for you.

Candidate requirements

  • Strong proficiency in React, React Native, Next.js, and TypeScript

  • Strong experience working with GraphQL APIs

  • Extensive AI/ML or agentic development experience using Cursor, Claude, or similar tools

  • Basic understanding of native mobile development concepts in Kotlin/Java and Objective-C/Swift

  • Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining production web and mobile applications

  • Strong understanding of performance, responsiveness, maintainability, and overall software quality

  • Proven ability to make architecture decisions independently and own technical direction

  • Ability to communicate clearly with clients and stakeholders

  • Full-time availability in a remote environment

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on development experience

  • Exceptional English communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Ability to pass a background check with good references

Details

  • Fully remote

  • Paid in USD

  • EST or PST aligned hours

text: Together we create incredible™ We harness the extraordinary power that’s sparked when people from all walks of life, all around the world, collaborate together. Our high-performing teams work with you to create innovative solutions that solve strategic business challenges and deliver outsized impact. You could work anywhere. Why 3Pillar? Search for jobs Accelerate your growth Our professional services model enables us to accelerate career growth and development opportunities — across projects, services, and industries. Our practice alignment provides the opportunity for targeted, specific growth in your area of expertise Invest in your well-being We want all our team members operating at their best. As a company, we spend a whole trimester in our annual cycle focused on well-being. Whether it’s taking advantage of fitness offerings, mental health plans (country-dependent), or simply leveraging generous time off, we know our teams work best when they’re comprised of happy, healthy professionals Be a citizen of the world At 3Pillar, you’ll join a global team, gaining insights from top talent worldwide and engaging with diverse cultures while speaking English daily. Our global workforce enables us to utilize resources from across the globe, fostering efficient and effective collaboration. You might even get the chance to visit your colleagues in exciting, new parts of the world! We work from anywhere With headquarters in the Washington, DC metro area and offices in North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America, our team members enjoy a flexible work environment that suits their own specific needs, whether that’s the office, home, or a blend of the two. 3Pillar Practices 3Pillar team members are skilled craftspeople who are driven to become the best in their respective fields. Explore each of 3Pillar’s practices below. Automation Our automation practice is comprised of professionals dedicated to streamlining business processes and enhancing operational efficiency through cutting-edge automation technologies. We specialize in robotic process automation (RPA), DevOps, Automated Testing, and more. By joining our Automation practice, you’ll be at the forefront of innovation, working in a dynamic environment where your contributions lead to tangible improvements and transformative business outcomes. Data Science & Analytics Our Data Science & Analytics practice is at the forefront of transforming raw data into actionable insights. They leverage advanced statistical methods, machine learning algorithms, and state-of-the-art technology to uncover patterns, predict trends, and generate meaningful business intelligence. Joining our practice means being part of an innovative environment where your skills will be honed and your impact will be significant, contributing to the success of our clients across diverse industries. Engineering & Architecture Our Software Engineering and Architecture team forms the core of our technology solutions, pioneering innovation and excellence in software development. We excel in building robust, scalable, and secure software applications tailored to our clients’ complex requirements. Our product engineering and architecture experts use best practices and the latest technologies to design, develop, and maintain top-quality applications. Joining our team means working with elite professionals in a dynamic and challenging environment, where your coding, system design, and problem-solving skills will be continually refined. Become part of a team dedicated to delivering outstanding software solutions and advancing the future of technology. Lifecycle Management Our Lifecycle Management Practice drives client success by seamlessly managing every phase of the product development lifecycle. Our Lifecycle Management Leaders, including Scrum Masters, Agile Managers, Program Managers and Senior Program Managers, act as CEOs of their engagements, ensuring client success across accounts, teams, and engagements. They are responsible for developing and executing tailored Account Governance Plans, managing program milestones, forecasting risks, fostering high-performing teams, handling senior client stakeholders, and identifying opportunities to grow with our clients. By supporting team members’ growth and ensuring alignment with client business outcomes, our Lifecycle Management team delivers exceptional products that outperform for our clients. Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your leadership and strategic thinking will ensure the continuous delivery of excellence and client satisfaction. Product Management Our Product Management team is central to delivering innovative and impactful products that meet and exceed our clients’ needs. We excel in defining product vision, strategy, and roadmaps, ensuring alignment between business goals and user requirements. Our product managers are skilled in agile methodologies, driving product development from concept to launch and beyond. Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack, Python)

The Role

Viventium is seeking a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) to help our fast-paced, innovative, and remote-first company. You will be responsible for building and delivering improvements to the company’s core hiring product, integrating with third-party technology partners, and innovating to provide high quality solutions.

In this role, you will work in an Agile environment with other skilled engineers, Product Managers, Product Designers, and Quality Assurance team members. You will design, implement, and deliver upon the shared vision.

Our ideal candidate is a passionate problem-solver and strong collaborator who is transparent about progress on tasks, seeks feedback early and often, and inspires colleagues to do better.

We believe in a highly collaborative and supportive team culture where ideas are celebrated, so it’s important that you are not only an accomplished Senior Software Engineer but also a critical and strategic thinker—and, of course, an exceptional team player. We are dedicated to ensuring this opportunity aligns with Apploi’s goals and contributes to your career path. Thank you for considering this role!

Who You Are

  • Passionate about TDD (Test First Development).

  • Work daily with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to design, implement, and review code.

  • Have built complex data models in an environment that produced high-quality data output.

  • Have at least 7 to 10 years of development experience with Python.

  • Have built applications using Django.

  • Have at least 2 to 3 years of experience with React.

  • Understands SOLID principle well.

  • Works to not only fix defects, but prevent future issues.

  • Have built complex applications with AWS Serverless technologies (AppSync, DynamoDB, DynamoDB Streams, Lambda, Cognito, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, Amplify)

  • Strong knowledge of GraphQL.

  • Have knowledge in DevOps and Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CICD)

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Passionate about engineering operational excellence.

  • Experienced with writing quality, reusable, readable code.

  • Worked in an environment that produced high-quality data output.

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Strong work ethic, integrity, and desire to succeed.

  • Adaptable to new initiatives.

What You’ll Do

  • Use continuous delivery practices to deliver high-quality software as well as value to end customers as early as possible.

  • Write production-ready code that is easily testable, easily understood by other developers, and accounts for edge cases and errors.

  • Understand the testing pyramid and write unit tests as well as higher level tests in accordance with it.

  • Collaborate with the team on integration to third-party systems.

  • Make pragmatic and data-driven decisions that will meet both business and technology needs.

  • Document key business workflows and software designs.

  • Communicate with the Quality Assurance (QA) team regularly. Work to deliver code in small chunks that can be tested early in development.

  • Collaborate with the Product and QA teams to realize feature designs.

text: Work with us from wherever you like Explore the remote job opportunities at Automattic. Work from anywhere, and make the web a better place for everyone, everywhere. Check out today’s open jobs. View open jobs We’re 1,382 Automatticians in 82 countries speaking 106 languages. We democratize publishing, commerce, and messaging so anyone with a story can tell it, anyone with a product can sell it, and everyone can manage their communications from a single source. Michelle Langston on her background as a designer, what drew her to Automattic, and what keeps her here. Our hiring process This is our standard process; however, the hiring steps may differ by role to ensure we choose candidates who will thrive as Automatticians. Application You submit a resume, cover letter, and (depending on the role) a few application questions, giving us a sense of your communication style and your alignment with our culture. We pay close attention to your answers, so share as much relevant information as possible, and dedicate real time to your cover letter, since thoughtful written communication matters a lot here. Once you submit, your application goes straight to a recruiter or hiring manager for review. If your application advances, we’ll invite you to complete a criteria assessment designed to evaluate the specific skills the role calls for. Initial interview Most roles start with a Slack interview, which is essential for evaluating text communication in our distributed company. Log in early, take your time with responses, and bring questions. (Note that you might see “Friendly Raccoon” create the channel but won’t conduct the interview itself.) For more tips, see Jerry’s guide to text-based interviews. Some roles call for more verbal back-and-forth, so we use 30 to 60 minute Video interviews instead. You’ll talk with a recruiter or hiring team member about your experience and career goals, so come prepared with specific examples that show your fit for the role and the company. Practical test or trial For some roles, you’ll complete a project that simulates real work in place of a traditional technical interview. This might be a shorter test, like a code test with an assigned buddy on existing code such as a WordPress plugin, or a longer trial of up to 20 hours using real work to check mutual fit, with feedback from your hiring team throughout. Either way, we’re evaluating problem-solving, design sense, and communication, not specific platform knowledge, so take the time you need. Most candidates finish within a week or so. Read more about what to expect. Final review and offer Once a candidate reaches this point, many teams hold a final interview, typically with an executive leader in the business unit. From there, the hiring team submits a recommendation, including your profile, feedback, and work summary, to the CEO for final approval, which can take anywhere from a few days to a month. If approved, HR will reach out to chat about your interview experience, compensation, and start date. Open jobs “I will strive to create inclusive spaces along my journey and intentionally seek out different perspectives.” At Automattic, we want people to love their work and show respect and empathy to all. We welcome differences and strive to increase participation from traditionally underrepresented groups. Automatticians across the company are encouraged to drive grassroots change, for example, facilitating private online spaces for affiliated Automatticians to gather and monthly People Lab series for further learning. Learn more about our Employee Resource Groups. Our dedication influences far more than just Automatticians: we make our products freely available and translate our products into and offer customer support in numerous languages. We ensure our products are accessible across different bandwidths and devices. “I love the fact that it’s very equal here, and actually everybody is used to just covering for somebody being on leave. I think that changes the perception of women a bit, like not being as worried about taking time out—because actually a lot of people take time out here for different reasons.” Nicola Hodd, Marketing Operations Read Nicola’s article What We Value Excellent Communication: As a distributed company, we rely on clear, thoughtful written communication. Autonomy and Self-Direction: We trust team members to manage their work without micromanagement. Continuous Learning: We value curiosity and willingness to develop new skills. Diverse Perspectives: We build better products when our team represents diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Open Source Ethos: We believe in transparency and giving back to the community. Read our Creed Benefits and Culture True Flexibility: Work from anywhere with internet access, on your own schedule. Competitive Compensation: We offer salaries based on skills, not location. Growth Opportunities: Internal mobility and continuous learning are encouraged. Open Vacation Policy: Take time off when needed, with no fixed limit. Equipment Allowance: We provide what you need to create your ideal workspace. Company Retreats: Teams gather once annually to collaborate in person. More about our Benefits Our remote-first culture This isn’t your typical work-from-home job. Everyone works from the location they choose, during the hours they choose. We’re spread out all over the world. We track about 70 percent of our projects on P2-themed WordPress.com blogs, 25 percent in private chat rooms, and the rest on Slack. Because of the geographic variance, we’re active 24/7. But don’t let that worry you. This is not a work-’til-you-drop place. We encourage work-life balance, and care about the work you produce, not the hours you put in. How We Work Why you’ll love working here Making the web a better place is rewarding in its own right, but we also provide professional growth, an open vacation policy, generous parental leaves, wellness support, sabbaticals, and more. Our main benefits are listed here. Additional benefits vary by location. Our Benefits We also meet(up) live Since the pandemic, we’ve focused on smaller groups, division meetups, and so on, that accomplish bonding and coworking on a manageable scale. Awesome places we’ve met include San Francisco, California; La Paz, Mexico; Oracle, Arizona; Breckenridge, Colorado; Mont-Sainte-Anne, Québec; Budapest, Hungary; San Diego, California; Santa Cruz, California; Park City, Utah; Whistler, Canada; Orlando, Florida; London, England; Dubai, United Arab Emirates; Madrid, Spain; Amsterdam, The Netherlands; Montreal, Québec; and many more.In addition to our larger meetups, individual teams meet for five to seven days to brainstorm team-level strategy and bond in locales ranging from Boulder to Buenos Aires, Las Vegas to Lisbon, Montréal to Mexico City, and Vienna to Vietnam. If you join our merry band, expect to travel three to four weeks per year. Travelling at Automattic Preparing Your Application When applying to Automattic, it’s important to research our products and values to ensure a strong alignment with our mission. Showcase relevant projects and contributions that highlight your skills and how they connect to the role you’re pursuing. In your cover letter, demonstrate excellent communication skills — clear, thoughtful writing is highly valued here. Be prepared to discuss how you work independently, manage your time effectively, and stay motivated without direct supervision. Finally, highlight any experience you have with distributed teams or remote work, as collaboration across time zones is a key part of how we operate. Apply for an open role Automated Tools in Our Hiring Process As part of our hiring process, Automattic may use automated tools to help evaluate, score, match, or verify candidates. This can include tools that assess application materials, detect fraudulent applications, verify identity, or support candidate sourcing. These tools support, but do not replace, review by our recruiting team. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, or a reasonable accommodation under applicable law, please fill out this form. “Talent and intelligence are equally distributed throughout the world, but opportunity is not.” — Matt Mullenweg, CEO YouTube Playlists – Employee Video Intros Watch the YouTube playlists below to see some current employees and friendly faces chatting about life at Automattic. Meet our Code Wranglers Meet our Mobile Engineers Meet our JavaScript Wranglers Meet more Automatticians Role and Team-Specific Information A few teams at Automattic have created their own resources and guides to document their specific recruiting processes. Some teams have also put together informational blogs about their projects and teammates. If you’re applying for one of the roles below, follow the links to learn more! text: Join us Build the Future with Us At Blankfactor, a Globant division, we’re not just building tech—we’re engineering impact. Our team is made up of the brightest minds in software engineering, data science, and digital innovation. We work with some of the biggest names in payments, banking, capital markets, and life sciences, delivering solutions that transform industries and create measurable value. Explore our open roles Culture Collage Investing in the Future At Blankfactor, our dedication to investing in our people doesn’t end with a single training session. We’re committed to fostering continuous growth and development, cultivating a culture where everyone thrives and evolves. Read full story here Sharing is caring Our DevOps guru, Dimitar Shukerski, delved deep into the core of DevOps, showcasing its indispensable role in today’s dynamic tech realm. Originating around 2009, the term “DevOps” marked a groundbreaking advancement in the software development lifecycle. DevOps transcends traditional software development boundaries and embraces the entirety of the software delivery lifecycle,… Read full story Strength, Skincare, and Success Celebrating Women at Blankfactor Women’s History Month isn’t just another four weeks on the calendar. It’s a tribute to the incredible strength, resilience, and achievements of women worldwide. We kicked off the celebration in style with a relaxing wellness workshop. What better way to wrap up the workweek than with a skincare session for… Read full story Cultivating a culture of continuous learning NextGen: A story of collaboration and growth At Blankfactor, fostering talent goes beyond simply offering opportunities — it means cultivating an environment of growth and innovation. Learn more about our colleagues and how we’re empowering future tech leaders. Read full story Embracing Medellin Global Mobility Program At Blankfactor, we’re proud to offer our team members the opportunity to live and work across the world — like Luciano Varisco, who moved to Colombia through our Global Mobility Program. Read full story Embracing the rhythm of Bulgarian folklore Kristiyan Dimitrov Software developer Meet Kristiyan Dimitrov, a Blankfactor software developer with a passion for Bulgarian folklore music. As Kristiyan observes, the world of folk dance has unexpected common ground with coding. Read full story Seeing from the lens of Blankfactor's CTO Lucho Hristov CTO, Bulgaria Our CTO, Latchezar H., is a physics graduate, a software engineer, a great leader, and a talented photographer with an eye for inspiring scenes. This one is from beautiful Tuscany in Italy. Read full story Code on wheels: Our VP of Engineering's passion Alper Hasan VP of Engineering “Motorcycling gives me a sense of freedom and relaxation, which in turn helps me come back to work with a clear mind,” Blankfactor’s VP of Engineering, Alper Hasan, shares. Read full story The rhythmic world of a QA engineer at Blankfactor Radu Telecan QA Engineer QA Engineer Radu Telecan has always had a passion for music. DJing since the 5th grade (using a double audio cassette player for a local school event), Telecan witnessed the field’s evolution and cultivated his hobby alongside his career in technology. DJing and QA engineering share common ground, Telecan says, as they… Read full story Our recruitment team Tejo Singh Senior Recruiter Whether you’re contemplating joining our team or simply curious about our inner workings, delve into the details and meet Tejo, our Senior Recruiter based in India. Read full story Energy synchronization There’s something truly special about the energy we share at Blankfactor. Walking into the office and seeing everyone kind of matching is pretty awesome. It’s not about being the same; it’s about showing we’re all on the same team. It makes the office feel more connected and, honestly, it’s just… Read full story Our values We’re always aiming for better and higher — and we believe everyone should be empowered to reach their full potential. Join us as we make a meaningful impact for our partners and the tech world. Treat people well Learn more Create opportunities Learn more Take ownership Learn more Go beyond the expected Learn more Celebrate the wins Learn more Spark joy Learn more Treat people well We believe the key to creating one-of-a-kind solutions is a strong team. Giving everyone a space to shine helps us challenge the status quo and deliver excellence. Create opportunities Great quality work thrives on diversity, so we build synergies, and bridges on diverse backgrounds, cultures, and working styles while encouraging everyone to collaborate. Take ownership Although we move as a group, we understand this is your effort as much as ours. So, if you can go out of your way to get things done, we foster you, by all means, to go ahead! Go beyond the expected Although we move as a group, we understand this is your effort as much as ours. So, if you can go out of your way to get things done, we foster you, by all means, to go ahead! Celebrate the wins To grow continuously is to learn continuously. We inspire ourselves to be role models and improve every day. Even our setbacks foster great chances for flexibility and growth. Spark joy Being clear, timely, and transparent is a way to spark our joy for others. We love what we do, and we want to make a better world with integrity, empathy, and assertiveness. Learning and development INITIATE Our dedicated learning platform, Init<iate>, empowers our engineers to excel in a wide range of technologies and roles. With a focus on cross-training and upskilling, our teams have the resources they need to build skills in communication, leadership, English proficiency, and more. Talent Academy Designed to help early-career developers grow into proficient software engineers, the Talent Academy combines hands-on learning, mentorship, and educational resources to teach everything from coding best practices to project management and teamwork. Collaborating with experienced mentors offers our teams guidance, code feedback, and the industry insights they need to take their careers to the next level. NextGen Internship Experience Our NextGen Internship Experience aims to shape junior-level developers through a culture of problem-solving, analytical thinking, and adaptability. The internship is a six-month, fully-funded program available at all our global offices. NextGen reflects a well-rounded, end-to-end engineering role at Blankfactor, which includes a mastery of technical and soft skills. Our benefits At Blankfactor, we understand that fostering a supportive environment isn’t just about the work you do — it’s about the experience you have while doing it. From comprehensive health and wellness programs to opportunities for ongoing learning and development, we’re committed to investing in your growth and well-being. Our team also enjoys exclusive perks and discounts with our trusted partners. A culture of continuous learning We give our teams the tools to stay curious. Company-provided resources for ongoing education, including Init<iate> and Talent Academy Yearly education credit for skill development Technology exams covered by the company Monthly workshops Beyond-the-desk workplace amenities We’re proud to have some of the best office chairs around (and other great things). World-class workspace for unleashing creativity Lunch provided when working from the office Fresh fruits and snacks in the office Friendly office atmosphere Where technology meets trust Our engineers thrive on interesting challenges supported by seasoned leaders. Diverse client portfolio of industry giants Cutting-edge high-tech stack Collaborative work environment Cross-functional client engagement teams The Blankfactor experience We value team building and time with our work family. Monthly on-site gatherings Annual festivities, including team-building activities, family BBQs, and end-of-year celebrations Participation in sporting events Voluntary social events Who we hire At Blankfactor, we aren’t just crafting best-in-class tech solutions; we’re engineering a brighter future. We’re looking for those who share our passion for innovation, excellence, and creating significant impact for the betterment of all. Our ideal candidates thrive in a dynamic environment and are motivated to contribute to a diverse range of projects — from full-stack development to enterprise AI. Whether you’re an expert in payments technologies or data engineering, people who are ambitious, talented, and ready to push boundaries can find a place at Blankfactor. Work with us How we hire Work with us Step 1 Apply Expect a friendly, insightful conversation with one of our talent acquisition specialists. We’ll discuss your background, skills, and motivations to see how they align with the role you’re applying for. It’s also a great opportunity for you to ask questions and get a feel for who we are. Step 2 Initial conversations Show us your skills. This coding exercise will assess your problem-solving and coding abilities in real-time. It’s not just about getting the right answers; we’re interested in your approach, how you think through problems, and how you apply your technical knowledge. This exercise helps us understand your proficiency in a practical, hands-on context. Step 3 Team interviews Here, you’ll dive deeper into technical discussions with one of our lead engineers. Expect questions related to your technical expertise, past projects, and specific technologies relevant to the role. This interview aims to gauge your technical acumen and how you apply your knowledge to solve complex problems. Step 4 Culture Sync Finally, we’ll go deeper to understand how you align with our company’s values and culture. We’ll discuss scenarios and hypothetical situations to understand your decision-making process, work ethic, and team collaboration skills. It’s an opportunity for both of us to ensure we’re a great match for each other. Work with us Our offices These are the cities we call home. We are located in both established and emerging global innovation hubs, including our headquarters in the U.S., LATAM, Europe, and South Asia. Sales & operations Engineering offices Why work with us Feedback is what keeps us improving, and our team is always encouraged to share their ideas. Here’s what a few of our team members had to say in a recent survey. “ “One of the most important things is people. I can see that management cares about people, which is especially important for me. Also, the excellent office location and the view. And of course, all the benefits that the company offers. I am glad to be here with all of these amazing professionals.” “ “Good career opportunities. Very competitive salaries and opportunities to socialize. Good company management. We can work from home from time to time. Nice work environment. Friendly colleagues.” “ “Giving employees the freedom to learn and grow. A sense of family among team members. Employee feedback is heard. Allowing employees to share their knowledge and suggestions keeps them engaged.” “ “I enjoy my work as I feel connected to my team. Also, I can speak freely with my manager as well as, the managers of the other teams. I particularly find that as a great advantage – not to feel a massive gap between junior and senior employees. I like flexibility – being able to work hybrid. I see a future in the company – I can develop professionally and as an individual seeing the example of other fellow colleagues.”

text: Careers Grow your career at the intersection of LATAM talent and US innovation Your go-to partner for high-quality outsourced solutions. Cafeto is where the best technology professionals in Colombia and Mexico come to work with the most interesting US clients — without leaving home. Join a team that invests in your growth and connects you to work that matters. See Open Positions Learn About Our Culture Why Work at Cafeto A team that invests in you — not just your output Work with US clients on real products Our engineers work embedded in US tech companies — exposure to the standards, tools, and culture of some of the most demanding technology environments in the world. Competitive salaries in local currency We pay competitive market rates in Colombia and Mexico. Your salary reflects the quality of your work — not the exchange rate of where you are located. Professional development support Access to certifications, training programs, and internal knowledge-sharing. Cafeto supports your career growth actively, not just on paper. Long-term stability We are not a staffing marketplace. When you join Cafeto, you are a Cafeto employee — with benefits, stability, and a team that is invested in keeping you. Bilingual environment English communication is a core part of the role — and a significant career differentiator. Cafeto strengthens your professional English in a real work context. A company that values people We are proud of our culture. Our engineers stay with us for years. The best indicator we can offer: talk to someone who works here. Who We're Looking For We recruit talent — not just resumes At Cafeto, the bar is high — and intentionally so. The US clients we work with expect senior, reliable, communicative engineers. Every candidate goes through a technical assessment, an English communication evaluation, and a culture fit interview before joining. We look for engineers who are technically excellent, professionally mature, and genuinely curious. We look for people who want a career, not just a contract. Open Positions Current opportunities at Cafeto Application Security Engineer (Java) 📍 Bogotá, Distrito Capital 🏠 Remote work Operacion Cafeto Apply Now → Senior Database Performance Engineer (PostgreSQL) 📍 Bogotá, Distrito Capital 🏠 Remote work Operacion Cafeto Apply Now → Senior Java Backend Engineer 📍 Bogotá, Distrito Capital 🏠 Remote work Operacion Cafeto Apply Now → See all open positions → Hiring Process What to expect when you apply 01 Apply Submit your resume and a short note about your experience and goals. 02 Technical Screen A skills assessment conducted by a senior engineer in your discipline. 03 English Assessment A 30-minute conversation to evaluate your professional communication. 04 Culture Interview A final conversation with our team to ensure mutual fit and discuss the role. Ready to take your career to the next level? See Open Positions

text: Careers at Cloudera Join the team. Search jobs Explore Opportunities at Cloudera We enable the world’s largest organizations across all industries to use data and AI to solve the impossible today. We empower our customers to transform decision making, boost bottom lines, safeguard against threats, and save lives. Recruitment Fraud Alert It has come to our attention that job seekers have been contacted about fake job opportunities with Cloudera from individuals fraudulently posing as Cloudera employees. These recruiting fraud schemes often include requests for personal information and payments. Be aware that Cloudera will never request a payment as part of its recruitment process. Additionally, Cloudera will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process. Any information submitted to Cloudera in relation to a job application should only be through our official career portal (https://www.cloudera.com/careers.html). Email communications from Cloudera will come from an email address ending in @cloudera.com. If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with law enforcement authorities. Cloudera is not responsible for fraudulent job offers and/or any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience connected to recruiting scams. People of Cloudera At Cloudera, we are a global community of passionate talent working together to solve the world’s most complex challenges across industries, from the top 9 global telcos to the top 8 global banks to leaders in healthcare. Our teams across Engineering, Marketing, HR, Sales, and Support span 34 countries, united by a shared commitment to enable organizations to bring AI to data anywhere, leveraging a proven open-source foundation. We believe in the Power of our people because when we bring together bold ideas, collaboration, and purpose, we do not just imagine the future - we help build it. See our customers #ClouderaLife At Cloudera, we are Customer Driven & People First! That means that while we are working hard to solve our clients' most complex data challenges, we are also making sure that every Clouderan feels valued, has growth opportunities, and that their well being is a priority. Check out what living the #ClouderaLife is all about. Learn more Corporate Social Responsibility Giving back has always been an integral part of the Cloudera culture. Through Cloudera Cares, our giving and volunteering program, our employees are encouraged and supported to volunteer and give to organizations where they live and work. It offers Clouderans with volunteering incentives, support and toolkits to aid more organizations in local regions. Learn more Our Culture At Cloudera, we are encouraged to bring our best selves to work every day. With a strong culture of belonging and a commitment to open dialogue. We run regular community building initiatives globally and you will find a place where you truly belong. Our 11 Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) foster connection, allyship, and support across our global team. Growing into the operating layer for enterprise IT.We started with a conviction: adding another vendor would never fix a fragmented industry. Better software, clearer ownership, and stronger service could.2012Software firstCommandLink begins with a simple idea: the industry’s hardest infrastructure problems need a software answer. Its proprietary ITSM foundation brings alerting, automation, analytics, engineering support, ticketing, and billing into one connected operating environment.2014Turning manual work into softwareCommandQuote and CommandDesk transform two traditionally complex workflows—telecom quoting and ticketing—into faster, more transparent software experiences. It is an early step toward giving customers greater visibility and control over every service interaction.2018Bringing the network into viewThe platform moves closer to the infrastructure it manages. Agile ticketing views and direct integrations with switching and Wi-Fi access points connect service workflows with real network activity, giving teams more context behind every issue.2019Connecting the modern edgeCommandAPI brings multiple SD-WAN and SASE environments directly into the CommandLink platform. Technologies that were previously managed in isolation begin operating through one shared ITSM experience.2020Building an open operating layerCommandAPI expands far beyond basic ticket eBonding. Open integrations with platforms such as ServiceNow bring inventory, performance, billing, and service data together—creating a more complete view of enterprise operations.2022Adding real-world contextNot every network incident begins inside the network. Utility outage monitoring adds power-event intelligence to the platform, helping teams identify root causes faster and respond with greater clarity.2024From visibility to actionCommandLink PRO expands the platform across connectivity, resilience, monitoring, and security. Automated LAN/WAN recovery, Starlink API integration, CommandMonitor, weather intelligence, and integrated MDR/XDR capabilities help teams detect, understand, and act from one place.2026+Building what comes nextCommandLink enters its next chapter with a five-year plan to invest $150–200M+ in new software. The focus: deeper intelligence, greater automation, and a more powerful platform that helps enterprises scale with fewer blind spots, fewer handoffs, and greater control.HOW WE WORKHigh ownership. Executive Director - Student Athlete Scholarships @ Stealth Educational Startup $400,000 USD/year ($200 USD/hour) Apply Now United States Fully-remote full-time (40 hrs/week) Flexible schedule Long-term role Key responsibilitiesIncrease attributable donations supporting K-12 scholarships for student athletes by owning the initiative's public credibility and the partnerships that convert it into funding.DescriptionSports communities know how to rally behind an athlete. This role turns that loyalty into scholarship funding: you are the public voice for student athletes and the person who converts trusted relationships into donations. Donors give to people they believe, and partners open their audiences only to leaders they'd vouch for. You will answer for the dollars that follow, not the applause. Stealth Educational Startup is recruiting for Student Athlete Scholarships, an initiative focused on K-12 scholarships for student athletes. Starting January 1, 2027, individuals can claim a federal tax credit for cash donations to approved Scholarship Granting Organizations in participating states. You will build the external engine that turns support for student athletes into donations: a credible media presence, speaking platforms and partnerships with companies, associations, organizations and influencers. You set the agenda and own the result. You decide which partners to pursue and which stages to take, negotiate and sign the agreements, and activate them into donor campaigns. Then you read the attribution data and put your effort where it raises money. Accuracy is part of the job. Every public claim you make or approve about school choices, student-athlete life and tax treatment has to hold up, and anything that needs legal review gets it. You report to the Board of Directors, and you will not run daily operations or administer scholarships, so your attention stays external. This is full-time remote work in the United States, 40 hours per week. If you want to be the face of a mission and be held to the dollars it raises, apply.Candidate requirements You know youth and high-school sports from the inside. You've been part of a young athlete's school decisions as the athlete, coach, counselor, recruiter or parent, and you can explain how training, travel and classes pull against each other when families weigh their options. You're at ease in front of a microphone or camera. You've given live and on-camera interviews as an official spokesperson, and you've pitched journalists, fielded press inquiries or engaged policymakers on an organization's behalf. You stay accurate when the questions get hard. You close. You've personally sourced and signed partnerships with companies, associations or membership organizations, each ending in a signed agreement or MOU. You know the difference between a warm intro and a deal. You know how to work with creators. You've negotiated or managed paid influencer or content-creator agreements and know how to keep a partner's audience engaged and the messaging on point. You make complex topics clear. You've explained tax or public policy to the public in plain language, through articles, explainers, FAQs, op-eds, testimony or interviews, with a sound process for checking your sources. You're ready to master federal scholarship tax-credit and SGO rules within your first 30 days. You work well on your own. You're based in the United States, available 40 hours a week, and used to driving results in a remote setting without needing someone to set your agenda.
