About Darwoft

Darwoft is a software factory delivering custom software solutions and IT staff augmentation services to international clients, primarily in the United States and Latin America. We partner with startups and scale-up companies to build high-impact digital products, combining technical excellence with a people-first culture built on long-term relationships and collaborative work.

Senior Fullstack Engineer (React/TypeScript/AI-Assisted Development) · LATAM

  • Location: Anywhere in LATAM
  • Work Model: 100% Remote
  • Engagement: Full-time Contractor
  • Project: FinTech · Customer Experience Operations Platform
  • English Level: Advanced
  • Seniority: Senior

Commitment & Focus

This role requires full-time dedication, with clear priority given to Darwoft projects during the established working hours. It is not compatible with other full-time professional engagements.

Any additional professional activities must be disclosed in advance and must not interfere with the responsibilities, availability, or working hours required for this role.

Get to Know Darwoft

At Darwoft, we build digital products with heart.

We're a Latin American technology company focused on creating impactful, human-centered software in partnership with companies around the world. Our remote-first culture is built on trust, continuous learning, collaboration, and strong engineering standards.

We're passionate about technology, but even more about the people behind it. If you're looking for an environment where your ideas matter, experimentation is encouraged, and your impact is tangible, welcome to Darwoft.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer with a strong frontend focus to join a high-impact international FinTech project building an internal Customer Experience Operations Platform.

The platform provides the tools customer experience agents and supervisors rely on every day to manage queues, assignments, conversations, agent availability, dashboards, metrics, and operational workflows.

You'll primarily design and ship agent-facing experiences using React and TypeScript, working within a modern, modular frontend architecture while collaborating closely with the backend services and APIs that power the platform.

A key aspect of this opportunity is the way the team approaches software development.

We're looking for engineers with an agentic development mindset: people who actively use AI coding assistants, LLM agents, automation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows to prototype faster, solve problems, generate and validate code, improve testing, accelerate debugging, and increase overall engineering productivity.

This is not simply about using AI autocomplete. We're looking for engineers who are comfortable incorporating tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, coding agents, custom scripts, or AI-assisted specifications into their day-to-day development process while maintaining strong engineering judgment and ownership.

You'll work closely with Product, CX stakeholders, designers, and backend engineers to turn operational requirements into reliable, intuitive, and scalable user experiences.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and maintain React / TypeScript features across CX domain modules, including operations tooling, agent presence, inbox workflows, queues, assignments, and internal applications.
  • Build and evolve reusable UI components, forms, tables, filters, dashboards, and complex operational workflows.
  • Work with technologies and patterns including Tailwind CSS, Tremor, Radix/shadcn, and Storybook.
  • Apply AI-assisted and agentic software engineering practices to accelerate prototyping, implementation, testing, refactoring, documentation, and debugging.
  • Experiment with AI coding agents and automated workflows to improve engineering productivity and development quality.
  • Build data-driven interfaces using TanStack Query, React Router, react-hook-form, and Zod.
  • Integrate frontend applications with BFF and backend APIs.
  • Work within a micro-frontend architecture using Rspack and Module Federation, respecting domain boundaries and monorepo conventions.
  • Collaborate on API design and integration with FastAPI backend services, including OpenAPI contracts and BFF endpoints.
  • Ensure end-to-end correctness across workflows involving queues, agents, assignments, conversations, and operational metrics.
  • Contribute to authorization-aware UX aligned with gateway permissions and domain-level capability models.
  • Troubleshoot issues across the frontend BFF backend stack using both traditional debugging techniques and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Ensure the reliability, accessibility, and performance of agent-critical workflows running in production.
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, technical decision-making, and engineering best practices around type safety, linting, testing, and maintainability.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong frontend-oriented background.
  • Strong production experience with React and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience actively using AI development tools and agentic workflows such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, coding agents, AI-assisted specifications, or similar tooling.
  • Ability to use AI as part of the engineering workflow while maintaining ownership over architecture, code quality, testing, and technical decisions.
  • Experience building complex product interfaces involving forms, tables, filters, dashboards, and multi-step workflows.
  • Strong understanding of modern frontend development practices and component-driven architectures.
  • Experience with modern bundlers such as Webpack, Rspack, or Vite.
  • Experience with Tailwind CSS or similar modern styling frameworks.
  • Experience consuming REST APIs and working with OpenAPI-based services.
  • Ability to debug and troubleshoot issues across frontend and backend boundaries.
  • Experience with modern state management and server-state patterns such as TanStack Query, React Context, and hooks.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and operational stakeholders.
  • Advanced English proficiency, both spoken and written.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing or integrating AI-agent workflows, AI-powered interfaces, or automated support operations.
  • Experience with micro-frontends or Module Federation.
  • Experience working with monorepos using pnpm, Turbo, Nx, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Refine, react-intl, or admin/operations-focused internal platforms.
  • Experience developing BFF layers with Node.js / Fastify.
  • Experience with Python / FastAPI, particularly the ability to understand APIs, propose schema changes, or implement small backend endpoints.
  • Experience working with PostgreSQL-backed services and transactional or domain-oriented APIs.
  • Experience in FinTech, payments, remittances, customer support platforms, or high-volume operational systems.
  • Experience with GCP, including technologies such as OIDC or Pub/Sub.
  • Experience with Docker and CI/CD in cloud-native environments.
  • Familiarity with Storybook, Vitest, and design-system workflows.
  • Experience working in fast-moving startup or scale-up environments.

What Darwoft Offers

  • Contractor agreement with payment in USD
  • 100% remote work
  • Argentina's public holidays
  • English classes
  • Referral program
  • Access to learning platforms

Explore this and other opportunities at:

www.darwoft.com/careers﻿

title: Senior Full-Stack Builder @ Katapult Labs
structured:
{"@context":"https://schema.org/","@type":"JobPosting","title":"Senior Full-Stack Builder","description":"

Senior Full-Stack Builder

Location: Remote (Latin America) | Type: Full-time

About Katapult

Katapult is an AI-first engineering studio connecting senior LATAM talent with startups and companies in the US. We're not a staff-augmentation shop: every person we put in front of a client represents Katapult, co-creates product, and owns the outcome directly, with no managers or leads acting as a layer in between.

About the role

We're not looking for a developer who executes tickets. We're looking for a builder engineer: someone with full product vision, able to move across architecture, backend, frontend, mobile and UX without waiting for someone else to tell them what to do (part Full-stack Engineer, part Designer, part Product Manager).

Technical depth is the floor here, not the differentiator. What actually sets builders apart is how they orchestrate AI agents day to day (planning work, running things in parallel, reviewing output critically), the harness they leave behind so agents and humans can keep running reliably on their work, and how well they see product, market and channel as one connected system rather than isolated tickets. Excellent communication is core to this role: you'll need to articulate product decisions clearly, align with stakeholders across functions, and make your reasoning legible to both humans and the AI agents you're directing because in a role this autonomous, how well you communicate is often what determines how far your work actually scales.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build product end-to-end alongside the client: architecture, data model, integrations, and the final interface, always with an eye on where each piece fits in the bigger picture.

  • Work in lean teams, typically starting at 2-3 people and scaling as the project grows, always with direct client exposure and no manager or lead absorbing that communication on your behalf.

  • Translate ambiguous business needs into a clear, executable technical plan, and argue for the why behind your decisions, not just the what.

  • Give proactive, honest updates and know when and how to push back on scope, asking the right questions early before a technical issue becomes a trust issue with the client. Invisible work reads as no work.

  • Use AI tools (like Claude and Claude Design) as a daily speed multiplier, leaving behind the context, rules, and tests that let agents run reliably on your work going forward. Katapult covers the cost of top-tier tooling so you can work at full capacity.

  • Co-create with the client rather than simply taking orders; actively help shape product decisions, not just implement them.

What we're looking for

  • Fluent English, enough to hold product and architecture conversations directly with US-based clients. This is client-facing work, so it's non-negotiable.

  • Solid full stack experience (backend + frontend); mobile or micro-frontend experience is a plus.

  • A track record of turning fuzzy product conversations into working architecture quickly, thinking about scalability, access control, and integrations from day one.

  • Real seniority: comfortable running an engagement solo when the client needs it, with a track record that includes both wins and lessons learned.

  • Prior experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders; startup or product-consulting backgrounds are a strong fit.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as a core part of your daily workflow, including planning and reviewing agent output critically, not just running prompts.

How we work

  • Our best-performing engagements are the ones where we co-create with the client at a strategic level, not the ones where we simply execute instructions.

  • Everyone on a project shares responsibility for communicating the value Katapult brings, consistently, not just shipping quietly in the background

Work-Life Balance

  • Work from Anywhere in Latin America: Enjoy the freedom to work remotely from any country in Latin America.

  • 23 Days of PTO per Year: Take time to recharge with paid time off, accrued monthly (1.91 days/month).

  • USA Federal Holidays

Financial Benefits

  • Monthly Payment in USD: Get paid in US dollars, no matter where you are.

  • Contractor Agreement with No End Date: Enjoy the stability of a long-term contract.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer @ Agility IO
structured:
{"@context":"https://schema.org/","@type":"JobPosting","title":"Senior Full Stack Developer","description":"

Location: Remote (Latin America)

Job Type: Full-time, Contract

About Us:

AgilityIO is a software development firm that designs and builds custom applications for startups and Fortune 500 companies. We are a global team of over 400 developers, QA engineers, project managers, and UX/UI designers with offices in New York City and Vietnam.

This is a full-time contractor role based in Latin America.

We are seeking a versatile Senior Full Stack Developer to build intuitive front-end experiences and scalable serverless backend systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working across the stack, with a strong focus on API integrations and modern web technologies.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Architect, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using modern frameworks (e.g., TypeScript/React, Node.js, Python)

  • Design and implement scalable backend services with AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, etc.)

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features

  • Ensure applications meet high standards of performance, responsiveness, and security

  • Lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and promote best practices

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines; monitor systems for reliability and performance

  • Stay current with emerging technologies and propose innovative solutions

Qualifications & Experience:

  • 5+ years of full-stack development experience

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and at least one backend language (Node.js, Python, or C#)

  • Deep knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture

  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and serverless architectures

  • Proficiency with modern frontend frameworks (React preferred; Angular or Vue a plus)

  • Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and microservices

  • Skilled in Git, testing frameworks, and agile methodologies

  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external teams in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer Associate)

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation)

  • Familiarity with DevOps practices and observability tools (e.g., AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus)

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses

  • Flexible remote work environment

  • Professional growth opportunities and mentorship

  • Engaging and collaborative team culture with cutting-edge projects

text: All open rolesENGINEERINGSenior Full-Stack EngineerHelp us build the PMS independent hotels actually love to use. You will own real surfaces end-to-end across TypeScript, React, and Cloudflare Workers.LocationRemote worldwideEurope, Asia, Africa, Middle East preferredTypeFull-timeAsync by default, 3h UTC overlapCompensationUSD 85k – 135kPlus meaningful equitySeniority5+ years productionSenior individual contributorApply for this roleBrowse other rolesABOUT THE ROLEWhat you will doYou will work directly with the founder and a focused engineering team. The work is full-stack in the real sense: you ship schema changes, API endpoints, front-end screens, and the emails that go out at 3am.Ship production features weeklyOwn real surfaces of the product, from arrivals and housekeeping to revenue dashboards and the channel manager integration.Design and build on the edgeBuild APIs on Cloudflare Workers, model data in D1, and use KV, R2, and Durable Objects where they actually help. We care about end-to-end design, not just endpoints.Own the front-end surfaceWrite production React and TypeScript for the front-desk, booking engine, and admin dashboards. Work side by side with design on every interaction.Talk directly to customersJoin onboarding calls, read support threads, and pull signals straight from hoteliers into the backlog.Review and raise the barHelp shape the codebase: review PRs, write internal docs, mentor teammates, and keep the platform maintainable as we grow.Keep it secure and operableWork on observability, incident response, and security hygiene. The platform handles real bookings and real payments every hour.STACKWhat you will work withWe stay boring on purpose and pick tools that let a small team move fast without breaking hotels.TypeScriptEverywhereReact + Next.jsFront-end & marketingCloudflare WorkersEdge APID1 (SQLite)Primary databaseTailwind CSSDesign systemCheckout.com & ChannexPayments & distributionWHAT WE EXPECTRequirementsYou do not need to tick every box, but most of these should feel familiar.5+ years of production experience as a full-stack or backend engineer working with TypeScript.Strong React and modern front-end skills, comfortable with Next.js, Tailwind, and real CSS.Deep familiarity with relational data modelling in SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, or D1).Solid understanding of HTTP, REST API design, authentication, and web security fundamentals.Clear written communication. Your PR descriptions and technical writing are part of the job.Experience owning a production system in a small team, including on-call or incident response.Comfort working mostly asynchronously, with at least three overlapping hours with 09:00 to 18:00 UTC.BONUS POINTSNice to haveNot required, but any of these make us want to hit reply faster.Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, D1, R2, or Queues.Hospitality, travel, or booking platform background. You understand why check-in matters.Experience integrating with payment processors (Checkout.com, Stripe) or channel managers (Channex).Prior work in regulated environments (PCI DSS, GDPR) or real SOC 2 programs.A portfolio of open-source contributions or a public body of work we can read.ONBOARDINGYour first 90 daysA transparent picture of what your first three months look like.Weeks 1–2Set up locally, pair with the founder, and ship a small real feature end-to-end. You will have read the codebase and talked to at least three customers.Weeks 3–6Own a vertical surface, usually one of: reservations, billing, housekeeping, or channel integrations. You drive design decisions and deliver production features behind feature flags.Months 2–3Participate in on-call rotation, propose improvements to the platform, and mentor the next engineer we bring on. By the end of month three, customers know your name.WHAT YOU GETBenefits and supportThe basics done properly. Nothing flashy, nothing hidden.Remote-firstEquity on day onePrivate health insuranceAnnual learning budgetUnlimited PTO with minimumTwo onsites per yearReady to apply?Send us a CV, a link to something you have built, and a short note on why SwiftGuest. We reply to every application within a week.No multi-round interview gauntletPaid work trial with real scopeTransparent compensation from the first conversationApply via email[email protected]

Our aim? To always be one step ahead. This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in Latin America. In addition to a competitive salary rate and a positive work environment, we are committed to delivering high-quality technology solutions. We also offer:Flexible schedules and authentic work-life balanceOpportunities for continuing educationPayment in US DollarsLaptop Provision About the role:Your work will be approximately 70% backend and 30% frontend, using Python, SQL, and AWS, alongside HTML, HTMX, and Jinja templates. QualificationsRequirements5+ years of professional software development experience, with a strong backend engineering background.Strong English communication skills (B2–C1 or above) for collaboration across teams.Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience building production backend services.Experience with PostgreSQL and/or MySQL; PostgreSQL is preferred.Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including data ingestion and processing.Experience deploying and managing applications on AWS.Experience with tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS CDK, or similar, plus familiarity with CI/CD.Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs and/or GraphQL, authentication, and authorization.Experience with unit and integration testing.Ability to work independently, lead technical efforts, and deliver practical solutions in a fast-moving environment. text: Back to jobsSenior Full Stack EngineerSão Paulo, Brazil ApplyAbout Us Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations. The Product You'll be working, as part of a small and fast-moving team, on Vyro, a worldwide Beast Industries platform connecting creators and brands. It's a product where correctness, trust, and speed all matter at once, and where a single creator moment can drive a surge of activity through every layer of the stack. That means: Features that must stay correct and consistent under bursty, launch-driven load, especially where the stakes are high. A client experience that feels seamless for two very different audiences across devices and network conditions. Code that lives in production and gets stress-tested every time a creator moment drives a wave of new users. What You'll Do Build and ship product features across the full stack using AI coding tools, contributing to a velocity that redefines what a small engineering team can deliver. Take ownership of your features end to end, from development through deployment, using AI-facilitated QA processes and tooling to maintain high engineering quality. Write clean, reliable, and performant code with a strong sense of accountability for what you ship in production, particularly where payments, verification, and content decisions are on the line. Collaborate closely with your teammates, contributing to a culture of high standards, fast iteration, and continuous learning. Who You Are AI-Native: You're already burning through tokens and using AI coding agents daily to move faster. Full Stack Engineer: 5+ years of hands-on experience building consumer-facing products across frontend and backend, with comfort moving between client and server as the product demands. Ownership Mindset: You take pride in what you ship, follow through on production issues, and don't consider a feature done until it's running reliably in the hands of users. Strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in TypeScript across the stack: Node.js (NestJS or equivalent) on the backend and React/Next.js on the frontend, with solid grounding in event-driven architecture. Our stack includes Next.js, Python, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, and AWS (EKS, ArgoCD) with canary deployments, and a Grafana + Sentry monitoring stack for observability. Bonus points for experience with payments and payout flows, ML-assisted moderation or fraud detection, media/content pipelines, or prior work at a consumer-scale company. Location: Remote (Brazil) · Reporting To: Director of Engineering · Compensation: [$78,000–$90,000 USD ] + equity + bonus 15% Benefits The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen. text: Newfire Global Partners > Careers Lead Full Stack Engineer (Node.js + React) Apply Now Region: LATAM Country: Costa Rica, Argentina, Colombia, and Mexico Type: Fully remote What's the Project? Newfire Global Partners is a leading technology firm that specializes in building transformative software solutions for some of the world’s most innovative companies. With a presence across four continents, Newfire Global brings deep expertise in digital healthcare, AI-driven analytics, and enterprise technology. The firm’s track record of delivering scalable, high-impact solutions has made it a trusted partner for organizations seeking to drive meaningful change through technology.We are passionate about the purpose-driven mission to help improve the quality of care for patients and are building a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive culture. We are a fully funded company founded by serial entrepreneurs with a stable client base.Opportunity for impactNewfire Global Partners, a leader in developing disruptive healthcare technology, collaborates with Fortune 500 companies and start-ups to drive transformation. Newfire is seeking a Senior/Lead Full Stack Engineer (Node.js + React ) What's the Project?The first part of the project focuses on enhancing the customer’s web registration and content experience to increase gym enrollment conversion and improve content discovery. The work is primarily front-end focused, with integration points into partner gym systems, and includes rebuilding the registration flow to support simultaneous gym enrollment, expanding bi-directional data sharing with gym partners, improving post-registration personalization, and enhancing search functionality and results presentation.The second part supports the customer’s Commercial enrollment funnels, which involve greater backend complexity due to payment and subscription handoffs. The scope consists of a series of targeted improvements across landing pages, personalization, feature flagging, and testing infrastructure, including integration with payment and subscription flows, implementation of LaunchDarkly for new commercial features, full automated test coverage for new or significantly modified code, and continued support for WordPress-based content delivery while contributing to the broader transition toward Contentful. You’re a perfect match if you have: 5+ years of professional full-stack development experience using TypeScript/React and Node.js (7+ years and prior technical leadership experience for Lead).Strong experience designing, building, testing, and maintaining scalable backend services and modern web applications.Hands-on experience working with WordPress, including custom integrations, APIs, plugins, themes, or headless CMS implementations.Experience integrating subscription, billing, or payment platforms, ideally Zuora.Experience working with Contentful or a comparable headless CMS.Experience implementing LaunchDarkly (or a comparable feature-flagging platform) — not just consuming flags, but structuring feature rollouts, experimentation, and progressive delivery.Strong knowledge of REST APIs, system integrations, data flows, and service-oriented architecture.Experience working with DynamoDB, Amazon RDS, or similar relational and NoSQL databases.Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools for coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and code review.Experience working in mature CI/CD environments and contributing to automated build, test, and deployment pipelines.Comfort with rapid prototyping, ambiguous scope, and shipping production-quality concept work — the R&D stream demands iterative delivery under evolving requirements.Strong understanding of software engineering practices: clean code, automated testing, version control, observability, and secure development.Experience collaborating with Product, Design, QA, and business stakeholders using tools such as Jira, Figma, Storybook, and Jellyfish.Strong communication skills in English and ability to work effectively in a distributed, cross-functional team, with meaningful daily overlap with US business hours.Ability to work within a regulated healthcare environment where reliability, privacy, HIPAA compliance, and data protection are essential.Ability to serve as the day-to-day technical point of contact with the client, proactively coordinating work across engineering, product, and QA, and making sure Senior team members are set up to be productive.Ability to guide architectural decisions, lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, and coordinate delivery across workstreams.Experience establishing development standards, improving engineering processes, and taking ownership of technical delivery and team outcomes.Please note that employment will be contingent upon providing documentation verifying your legal work authorization in the country of residence, in accordance with applicable law. Your day-to-day activities: Build and maintain full-stack applications using TypeScript/React and Node.js.Develop integrations with WordPress, Contentful, Zuora, and internal clients' systems.Design APIs, backend services, data flows, and solutions using DynamoDB and RDS.Stand up and evolve feature flag configurations in LaunchDarkly to support progressive delivery.Use AI-assisted coding tools while ensuring code quality, security, and maintainability.Contribute to automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.Collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and DevOps to deliver reliable healthcare solutions.Translate exploratory R&D concepts (mental health screeners, GLP-1 integrations, clinical adjacencies) into production-quality experiments.Serve as the day-to-day technical interface with the client's team, coordinating work with the client PM and ensuring Senior team members are productive.Lead technical design, planning, mentoring, and delivery of complex initiatives across the three workstreams.As a Senior team member, you will be expected to actively participate in our hiring processes by serving on interview panels for future roles across the companyNice to haveExperience in healthcare, health technology, insurance, or another regulated industry.Familiarity with AWS and cloud-native development.Familiarity with Datadog for observability, APM, logging, and alerting (part of the project stack).Experience with design systems, Storybook, accessibility (WCAG), and responsive applications.Knowledge of healthcare security, privacy, or interoperability requirements (HIPAA, HITRUST, FHIR).Prior experience with clinical instruments (PHQ-2/PHQ-9 or similar), telehealth, or health-tech incubation work.Experience introducing AI-enabled development practices across engineering teams. text: Sr Fullstack Developer - Remoto Buenos Aires, Argentina Full-Time Remote Apply now Share: Job Description: Sobre la posición ¿Te apasiona construir productos digitales modernos, rápidos y escalables? Buscamos un/a Senior Full Stack Developer con fuerte dominio del ecosistema de TypeScript, React y Next.js, sumado a experiencia práctica en Node.js y Java. Trabajarás en el desarrollo end-to-end de aplicaciones web modernas en un entorno dinámico, enfocado en buenas prácticas y libre de micromanagement, donde tu impacto se notará desde el primer día. ¿Cuáles serán tus desafíos / responsabilidades? Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener aplicaciones web robustas liderando el frontend con React y Next.js (SSR, SSG, App Router).Implementar y mantener la capa BFF (Backend for Frontend) utilizando TypeScript, Node.js y Express (o frameworks similares).Desarrollar, mantener e integrar servicios y APIs REST backend en Java según las necesidades del proyecto.Garantizar la escalabilidad, rendimiento, mantenibilidad y seguridad en el diseño de APIs (autenticación, autorización y datos sensibles).Escribir tests unitarios y de integración en las distintas capas (Jest, Vitest, JUnit o equivalentes).Colaborar activamente en decisiones de arquitectura y despliegues a entornos dev, staging y producción. ¿Qué buscamos en vos? (Requisitos Excluyentes) Experiencia en Frontend: Experiencia sólida, comprobable y en entornos de producción reales trabajando con React y Next.js (App Router / SSR / SSG). (Deal-breaker: Sin experiencia sólida en React en producción).Experiencia en Backend & Lenguajes:Dominio obligatorio de TypeScript (en frontend y Node.js).Experiencia práctica y real en backend con Java en proyectos productivos (no solo nivel académico o cursos).Base sólida y práctica en Node.js / Express implementando capas BFF o microservicios.APIs & Integración: Dominio en el desarrollo e integración de APIs RESTful.Testing & Calidad: Experiencia en tests unitarios y de integración (Jest, Vitest, JUnit), además de buenas prácticas (Clean Code, Git).Seguridad: Conceptos claros de autenticación, autorización y protección de datos en APIs. Deseables (Nice-to-Have) Spring Boot / Spring Framework.AWS, Docker y pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions / DevOps).Bases de datos relacionales (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) y NoSQL (MongoDB).Integración de pasarelas de pago (Stripe) y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos (RabbitMQ / Kafka).Conocimiento de GraphQL. text: Back to jobsSenior Software Engineer (Full-Stack, JavaScript)Remote, LatAmApplyBack in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things, so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter, defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. About the Role We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to design and build high-quality products using Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript. You will operate across architecture and delivery, taking ownership of systems while also guiding teams and driving technical direction. What We’re Looking For Day-to-Day Responsibilities Design and build end-to-end applications across frontend and backend. Define system architecture, APIs, and data models for scalable products. Lead technical discovery by understanding systems, constraints, and opportunities. Guide engineering decisions and support other engineers through design and code reviews. Partner with product and design to shape solutions from idea to implementation. Write and review code with a focus on quality, performance, and maintainability. Communicate clearly with stakeholders on approach, progress, and risks. Drive delivery while helping maintain a high technical bar across the team. Required Skills & Experience 10+ years building production-grade applications with real-world complexity. Experience operating as a technical lead or owning significant parts of a system. Strong expertise in JavaScript or TypeScript, React including Next.js, and Node.js. Experience building full-stack applications across frontend and service layers using modern TypeScript frameworks such as React, React Native, or NestJS. Experience designing and building APIs using REST and GraphQL. Strong experience working with databases and data modeling across systems such as PostgreSQL, MySQL or DynamoDB. Strong understanding of system design, application architecture, and scalable system patterns. Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Experience producing clear architecture documentation and guiding implementation. Strong ownership with the ability to drive problems end-to-end. text: Back to jobsSoftware Engineer, Open Source AI Remote - Colombia ; Remote - Costa Rica ; Remote - MexicoApplyAbout Backblaze Backblaze provides reliable, high-availability cloud storage trusted by consumers, SMBs, enterprises, and developers in over 150 countries. Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage supports data-intensive workloads including backup, media, analytics, and modern AI pipelines. Our teams focus on building durable, scalable systems with a strong emphasis on developer experience and operational efficiency. Role Overview We are seeking a Software Engineer to build and maintain open source AI integrations, frameworks, and example applications that make Backblaze B2 Cloud Storage a natural part of how AI workflows are constructed and deployed. This is a front-row seat to the AI ecosystem as it evolves, working directly with the latest AI startups, open source frameworks, and developer tools. This role is expected to actively use the latest AI coding agents and tools as part of everyday development work. The primary objective is to build and contribute production-quality open source integrations, new frameworks, and end-to-end example applications that demonstrate how B2 supports AI workflows. A practical understanding of AI workflows, agent-based systems, and data orchestration is required. This role demands continuous learning and hands-on testing of emerging AI frameworks and APIs as they mature, and is best suited for someone genuinely excited to work at the forefront of AI development. What You’ll Be Doing Use AI coding agents to build coding harnesses to accelerate the development, testing, and maintenance of public and internal applications, SDKs, notebooks, and reference implementations that demonstrate AI and cloud storage best practices. Implement and maintain open source AI integrations, frameworks and example applications using languages commonly used in the open source ecosystem, including Python, TypeScript, Go, and Rust. Use AI-assisted development tools, including Claude Code, to accelerate implementation while validating correctness, security, and performance. Contribute to open source projects through code contributions, issue triage, reviews, and ongoing maintenance. Ensure all open source assets meet high standards for testing, documentation, reproducibility, and developer usability. Maintain clean, well-structured GitHub repositories intended for external adoption and community contribution. Collaborate with Product and QA to ensure integrations reflect real customer AI workflows and Backblaze B2 usage patterns. Tools and Technologies Languages: Python, TypeScript, Go, JavaScript and other open source languages Backblaze B2 SDKs and REST APIs Open source AI frameworks and tooling AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, Antigravity and Codex Jupyter and Google Colab notebooks GitHub, pytest, CI pipelines What We’re Looking For Software engineer with experience contributing to open source projects in one or more widely used open source languages. Comfortable owning and maintaining public repositories with external users and contributors. Practical understanding of AI workflows, including data ingestion, preprocessing, inference, and agent-based systems. Experience writing production-quality code with strong testing and documentation practices. Strong written communication skills with a focus on developer experience and adoption. Why Backblaze Build open source software used by developers worldwide. Work at the intersection of AI, data, and cloud storage. Collaborate with experienced engineering, product, and QA teams. Competitive compensation and benefits. Remote-first culture supporting work-life balance. At this point, we hope you are excited about the opportunity. Even if you do not meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. Learning, development, and growth are important parts of our culture. We are eager to meet people who believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in different ways. We want employees to feel comfortable bringing their full selves to work and doing their best work here. At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are central to those values. We are committed to fostering a workplace where employees experience a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socioeconomic status, ability, veteran status, or education. We believe a diverse workforce helps us better serve customers around the world and reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. Backblaze is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. text: Back to jobsFull Stack Web DeveloperLATAMApplyRole OverviewWe are seeking a Senior Full Stack Web Developer to join an engineering team supporting a global entertainment and media organization. You will work within an agile development team, partner closely with product management, perform code reviews, and mentor other developers as you help build and maintain high-quality web applications. This role is a strong fit for self-motivated engineers who are passionate about both the business and the technology behind it. Deep knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Node.js is essential, and hands-on experience with React, Redux, Jest, Azure SQL, and MongoDB is a strong plus. Just as important is the ability to adapt quickly as technologies and priorities change. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain web applications using modern web technologies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product management, to define, design, and ship new features. Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code. Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications. Identify and resolve bottlenecks and fix bugs. Guide and mentor other full stack developers on business and technical concepts to improve code quality and delivery speed. Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation across the codebase. Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers. Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies. Required Qualifications Minimum of five (5) years of experience as a Full Stack Web Developer or in a similar role. Mastery of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript, along with frameworks like React, Angular, or Vue.js. Strong experience with a Node.js framework such as Hapi.js or Express.js. Experience with database systems such as MongoDB, MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar. Experience working on large single-page web applications with complex state management. Familiarity with UI frameworks such as Bootstrap, Semantic UI React, Material, Tailwind, or similar. Experience writing unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Chai, Cypress, or similar. Experience performing code reviews to ensure security, code quality, maintainability, and knowledge sharing across the team. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and web services. Very strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and teamwork skills. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Preferred Experience Hands-on experience with React, Redux, Jest, Azure SQL, and MongoDB. Experience with SAP/BTP integrations. Experience with cloud services such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Experience working in FinTech or financial systems environments. Experience working in agile development teams. Experience mentoring or leading other developers. Ideal CandidateThe ideal candidate is a seasoned full stack engineer who takes ownership of quality, from clean code and solid test coverage to thoughtful code reviews. They are comfortable working across the front end and back end, collaborate easily with product and engineering peers, and enjoy helping other developers grow. Just as important as technical depth is the ability to adapt to changing technology, understand the business context behind the work, and contribute to a team culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
